summary: Payroll & Accounting Reporting Center integration (payroll summary & slips, allowances/bonuses/deductions, payroll variance, departmental allocation, liabilities & reconciliation, journal entries)
acceptance: Integration of Payroll & Accounting reports into the centralized Reporting Center catalog
Payroll Summary & Detail Report (RPT-PAY-01): Gross pay, prorated salary, allowances, bonuses, deductions, net pay, period status indicator (draft vs closed)
Salary Components & Deductions Breakdown (RPT-PAY-02): Aggregation by component type, taxable vs non-taxable allowances, statutory deductions
Payroll Variance & MoM Trend Report (RPT-PAY-03): Period-over-period headcount and payroll fund fluctuation, variance percentage
Departmental Cost Allocation & Accrual (RPT-ACC-01): Cost allocation by department and unit, expense accounts (VAS 6421, 6422), employer overheads
Payroll Liabilities & Reconciliation (RPT-ACC-02): Payable liability (3341), disbursed payments (1121/1111), remaining balance, unpaid slips
General Ledger Journal Entries Report (RPT-ACC-03): Debit/Credit balance audit, posted vs draft entries, reversal traceability
Strict tenant isolation, RBAC (Admin/HR full company, Manager scoped, Employee self-only payslips), exact decimal arithmetic, CSV export with UTF-8 BOM and audit logging
